verdict.rationale: Steel describes controlling "fleets of browsers in the cloud" and spinning up isolated sessions on demand, with auth context reusable across multiple sessions. That implies agents can run work in parallel across many sessions, but nothing documents a dedicated bulk or batch operation. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API (e.g., bulk scrape or bulk session actions), any concurrency limits or fan-out examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
